name: VetVR
summary: Step into the world of veterinary care with Vet VR, an engaging and interactive virtual reality experience. As a skilled veterinarian, you'll welcome a variety of sick or dirty animals into your clinic. It's your job to identify their problems, apply the right treatments, and ensure they leave in perfect health. With its hands-on gameplay and realistic scenarios, Vet VR offers an exciting way to care for animals while testing your problem-solving skills in a fun and heartwarming environment.
